gripper_delayed_readback_s [0.25,0.75,1.5] -> [1.2,2.0,3.0]. Run console_b90314bcfb8e42879c5ea9fa07de5df1 passed preflight/pregrasp/contact/close and then stopped at VERIFY_BEFORE_LIFT with GRIPPER_STABLE=false: the delayed samples read 104 -> 39 -> 39 raw, i.e. the first sample was taken while the Inspire fingers were still closing (spread 65 > maximum_readback_spread_raw 20; GRIPPER_HOLD was already true). Only the sampling instants change - the 20 raw spread / 20 raw hold thresholds and every gate stay untouched - and the window matches demo3's physically proven [1.2,2.0,3.0] on the same gripper.

new optional --settle-tail N: repeats the final commanded pose for N cycles (0.08 s each) after every packaged segment and rebinds sample_count/duration/native_path_sha256/native_file_sha256 . The file header's sample count MUST be rewritten too - leaving it alone made the sender loader report 'trailing data' in run console_ce7de8367c1145fd8974bd1a152b2b2f (that run never moved). Default 0 keeps demo3 byte-identical; only the demo2 entry points (console, run_pick_reset_demo.py, run_pick_reset_timing.py spawn) pass native_settle_tail_samples.

the background native packager call now forwards --settle-tail from parameters.json:native_settle_tail_samples (10) so lift230/lower230 get the same stationary tail as the initially packaged segments.

the per-segment native prevalidate loop now runs through measured('PREVALIDATE_<SEGMENT>') so status.json/events.json name the real phase. Before this, a prevalidate failure (e.g. the 16:15 'trailing data') was reported under the last finished stage GRIPPER_RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT, which read as 'stuck at the gripper check'.

transient handling so a single read hiccup no longer kills a whole run: (1) read_telemetry() retries ONLY read-only failures (telemetry transport / base-window freshness) 4x0.75 s; (2) a segment that fails before any dispatch restarts once from a fresh read; (3) a native sender fault with ZERO samples, a confirmed Servo cleanup, a clean controller and joints within 0.02 rad of the path start gets exactly one re-dispatch of the same file (demo0/demo5 rule). Motion gates, preflight and history checks are untouched.
